points.why: It names Accidental Adversaries and shows each side's fix hurting the other, but never says the two groups are natural allies with a shared goal of fast, good hires.
It traces volume to weak candidates, to more filtering and rejections, to longer time-to-fill, and back to more volume, and calls the loop reinforcing.
It says each fix works by its own measure, that both stories are accurate, and that neither explains the loop alone.
It recommends joint intake and calibration, presenting the loop as a shared structure, and metrics tied to screening pass-through rather than raw speed.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly declines to take either side.
It names Accidental Adversaries and never mentions Escalation.

notes: It wrongly says every link is 'more leads to more' with no minus signs, though step 2 has volume lowering quality, and 'escalates without limit' overstates it.
